chunks: Safwan ibn Mihran narrated from Amir ibn al-Simt, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who has intercourse with his sister, he said:
He is struck with a sword, and whatever it reaches of him, it reaches. If he survives, he is kept permanently in prison until he dies.

key_terms.خُلِّدَ: he is made to remain permanently
key_terms.يَقَعُ: has intercourse; engages in sexual relations
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is struck; a corporal legal punishment is carried out on him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a man who commits intercourse with his sister?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who commits intercourse with his sister. Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام states that he is to be struck with the sword, and if he survives, he is to remain imprisoned until death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3261 - Safwan ibn Mihran narrated from Amir ibn al-Simt, from Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) regarding a man who commits intercourse with his sister.
He is struck with a sword, and whatever injury it causes will be his fate. If he survives, he is to be imprisoned for life until he dies."
